verses.t: oracle word-of YHWH toward Israel ; in-hand-of Malachi.
I-have-loved you-pl YHWH has-said, and-you-pl-have-said in-what you-have-loved-us ; is-it-not brother Esau to/for-Jacob utterance-of YHWH, and-I-have-loved Jacob.
and-Esau I-have-hated ; and-I-have-put mountains-of-him desolation, and-inheritance-of-him to/for-dragons-of wilderness.

for Edom will-say we-have-been-beated and-we-will-return and-we-will-build wrecks, thus YHWH has-said hostses, they will-build and-I will-overthrow ; and-they-have-called to/for-them border-of wickedness, and-the-people who has-indignanted YHWH until age.
and-eyes-of-you-pl they-f-will-see ; and-you will-say YHWH let-magnify, on to/for-border-of Israel.

son will-honor father and-servant lords-of-him ; and-if father I where glory-of-me and-if lords I where fear-of-me has-said YHWH hostses to/for-you-pl the-priests despising-of name-of-me, and-you-pl-have-said, in-what we-have-despised name-of-you.
making-approach on altar-of-me food defiled, and-you-pl-have-said in-what we-have-defiled-you ; in-say-of-you-pl, table-of YHWH despised he.

and-for you-pl-will-make-approach blind to/for-sacrifice naught bad, and-for you-pl-will-make-approach lame and-weaking naught bad ; make-present-him please to/for-governor-of-you is-it-will-accept-you or is-it-will-lift faces-of-you, YHWH has-said hostses.
and-now entreat please faces-of El and-let-him-gracious-us ; from-hand-of-you-pl she-has-been this-f, is-it-will-lift from-you-pl faces, YHWH has-said hostses.
who also in-you-pl and-let-shut doors, and-not you-pl-will-make-shine altar-of-me for ; naught to/for-me pleasure in-you-pl has-said YHWH hostses, and-offering not I-will-accept from-hand-of-you-pl.

for from-east-of sun and-until entrance-of-him great name-of-me in-the-nations, and-in-all-of place been-made-incense been-made-approach to/for-name-of-me and-offering pure ; for great name-of-me in-the-nations, has-said YHWH hostses.
and-you begining him ; in-say-of-you-pl table-of lords-of-me defiled he, and-fruit-of-him despised food-of-him.

and-you-pl-have-said behold is-it-from-weariness and-you-pl-have-made-breathe him YHWH has-said hostses, and-you-pl-have-made-come plundered and-the-lame and-the-weaking, and-you-pl-have-made-come the-offering ; is-it-I-will-accept her from-hand-of-you-pl YHWH has-said.
and-cursed ploting and-there in-flock-of-him male, and-vowing and-sacrificing been-made-ruin to/for-lords-of-me ; for king great I has-said YHWH hostses, and-name-of-me feared in-the-nations.
and-now toward-you-pl the-commandment the-this-f the-priests.

if not you-pl-will-hear and-if not you-pl-will-put on heart to/for-give glory to/for-name-of-me has-said YHWH hostses, and-I-have-sended in-you-pl the-curse, and-I-have-cursed blessings-of-you-pl ; and-also I-have-cursed-her, for naught-you-pl puting on heart.
lo-me rebuking to/for-you-pl the-seed, and-I-have-scattered refuse on faces-of-you-pl, refuse-of feasts-of-you-pl ; and-he-has-lifted you-pl toward-him.
and-you-pl-have-known, for I-have-sended toward-you-pl, the-commandment the-this-f ; to/for-be covenant-of-me with Levi, has-said YHWH hostses.
covenant-of-me has-been with-him the-lifes and-the-peace, and-I-have-given-them to/for-him fear and-has-feared-me ; and-from-faces-of name-of-me he has-been-dismayeded.
instruction-of truth has-been in-lip-of-him, and-injustice not has-been-found in-lipses-of-him ; in-peace and-in-plain he-has-gone with-me, and-many he-has-made-return from-iniquity.
for lipses-of priest they-will-keep knowledge, and-instruction they-will-seek from-lip-of-him ; for messenger-of YHWH hostses he.
and-you have-turned from the-way, have-made-stumble many in-the-instruction ; you-pl-have-ruined covenant-of the-Levi, YHWH has-said hostses.
and-also I have-given you-pl despised and-low to/for-all-of the-people ; like-lip-of who naught-you-pl keeping ways-of-me, and-lifting faces in-the-instruction.
is-it-not father one to/for-all-of-us, is-it-not El one has-created-us ; why we-will-treacherously man in-brother-of-him, to/for-begin covenant-of fathers-of-us.
Judah and-abomination has-treacherouslied, has-been-done in-Israel and-in-Jerusalem ; for Judah has-begun holiness-of YHWH who has-loved, and-has-marrieded daughter-of El-of foreign.
YHWH let-make-cut to/for-the-man who will-do rousing and-answering, from-tents-of Jacob ; and-making-approach offering, to/for-YHWH hostses.
and-this-f second you-pl-will-do, cover tears altar-of YHWH, weeping and-groaning ; from-naught still turn toward the-offering, and-to/for-take acceptance from-hand-of-you-pl.
and-you-pl-have-said on what ; on for YHWH has-made-testify between-you and-between woman-of youths-of-you who you have-treacherouslied in-her, and-he consort-of-you and-woman-of covenant-of-you.

and-not one and-remnant-of spirit has-done to/for-him, and-what the-one, seeking seed-of god ; and-you-pl-have-been-kept in-spirit-of-you-pl, and-in-woman-of youths-of-you do-not let-him-treacherously.
for has-hated send YHWH has-said god-of Israel, and-has-covered violence on clothing-of-him, has-said YHWH hostses ; and-you-pl-have-been-kept in-spirit-of-you-pl and-not you-pl-will-treacherously.

you-pl-have-made-weary YHWH in-words-of-you-pl, and-you-pl-have-said in-what we-have-made-weary ; in-say-of-you-pl all-of doing-of bad good in-eyes-of YHWH and-in-them he has-delighted, or where god-of the-justice.

lo-me sending messenger-of-me, and-has-turned way to/for-faces-of-me ; and-suddenly temple-of-him the-lord will-come toward who you seeking and-messenger-of the-covenant who you delighting behold coming, has-said YHWH hostses.
and-who sustained day-of come-of-him, and-who the-standing in-be-see-of-him ; for he like-fire refining, and-like-lye washer'sing.

and-has-dwelt refining and-puring silver, and-has-pured sons-of Levi and-has-refined them, like-the-gold and-like-the-silver ; and-they-have-been to/for-YHWH, making-approach-of offering in-rightness.
offering-of Judah and-has-pleased to/for-YHWH, and-Jerusalem ; like-days-of age, and-like-years eastern.

and-I-have-presented toward-you-pl to/for-the-justice and-I-have-been witness hastening in-the-sorcerying and-in-the-commiting, and-in-the-sweared to/for-the-deception ; and-in-oppressing-of wages-of hired widow and-orphan and-making-stretch-of sojourner and-not have-feared-me, YHWH has-said hostses.
for I YHWH not have-changed ; and-you sons-of Jacob not have-finished.

to/for-days-of fathers-of-you-pl you-pl-have-turned from-statutes-of-me and-not you-pl-have-kept, return toward-me and-let-me-return toward-you-pl, YHWH has-said hostses ; and-you-pl-have-said in-what we-will-return.
man god is-it-will-rob for you robing me, and-have-said in-what we-have-robed-you ; the-tithe and-the-contribution.
in-the-curse you cursed, and-me you robing ; the-nation all-of-him.

make-come all-of the-tithe toward house-of the-treasure and-let-be prey in-house-of-me, and-test-me please in-this-f, has-said YHWH hostses ; if not I-will-open to/for-you-pl windows-of the-heavens, and-I-have-made-empty to/for-you-pl blessing until without sufficiency.
and-I-have-rebuked to/for-you-pl in-the-eating, and-not he-will-destroy to/for-you-pl fruit-of the-ground ; and-not the-vine will-bereaved to/for-you-pl in-the-field, has-said YHWH hostses.
and-they-have-blessed you-pl all-of the-nations ; for you will-be land-of pleasure, has-said YHWH hostses.
words-of-you-pl have-strengthened on-me has-said YHWH ; and-you-pl-have-said, what we-have-been-spoken on-you.
you-pl-have-said, vanity serve god ; and-what unjust-gain for we-have-kept charge-of-him, and-for we-have-gone mournfully, from-faces-of YHWH hostses.
and-now, we blessing arrogant ; also they-have-been-built doing-of wickedness, also they-have-tested god and-they-have-been-escaped.

then they-have-been-spoken fear-of YHWH man with neighbor-of-him ; YHWH and-has-made-heed and-has-heard, book-of memorial and-has-been-written to/for-faces-of-him to/for-fear-of YHWH, and-to/for-devising-of name-of-him.
and-have-been to/for-me YHWH has-said hostses, to/for-the-day, who I doing possession ; and-I-have-spared on-them, like-when man will-spare, on son-of-him the-serving him.
and-you-pl-have-returned and-you-pl-have-seen, between just to/for-wicked ; between serving-of god, to/for-who not has-served-him.

for behold the-day coming, burning like-the-ovens ; and-have-been all-of arrogant and-all-of doing-of wickedness stubble, and-has-kindled them the-day the-coming YHWH has-said hostses, who not will-leave to/for-them root and-branch.
and-has-risen to/for-you-pl afraid-of name-of-me sun-of rightness, and-healing in-wings-of-her ; and-you-pl-have-exited and-you-pl-have-leaped like-calfs-of stall.
and-you-pl-have-pressed wicked, for they-will-be ash, under palms-of foots-of-you-pl ; in-the-day who I doing, YHWH has-said hostses.
remember, instruction-of Moses servant-of-me ; who I-have-commanded him in-Horeb on all-of Israel, statutes and-justices.
behold I sending to/for-you-pl, Elijah the-prophet ; to/for-faces-of come day-of YHWH, the-great and-the-feared.
heart-of fathers and-has-made-return on sons, and-heart-of sons on fathers-of-them ; lest I-will-come, and-I-have-made-smite the-land devoted.
